DevXDK v0.1.0-rc.4 — app release.

- App source: devxdk/devxdkcode@045757fa88978725df96a0096094077ac7a5687b (private repo, tag v0.1.0-rc.4).
- The app-v0.1.0-rc.4 tag targets manifest-repo commit 2aa4c1439308487f0f1ef0bc7b236b616aa0d382.
- Provenance: see the minisigned provenance.json asset.

Linux requires glibc 2.35 or newer, GTK3, and WebKitGTK 4.1. The .deb installs
the runtime dependency through the package manager. Before using the AppImage
on Debian 12 / Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, run:

    sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0

The AppImage uses the system webview and its matching helper programs.
Corresponding sources and licenses for the embedded AppImage runtime:
https://github.com/devxdk/devxdk/releases/tag/tools-linuxdeploy-20260906
